Backend: new tests/test_iteration3_fixes.py 13/16 pass - PATCH order status fechada/cancelada/garbage -> 400, valid status ok; DELETE fechada order -> 400 (status unchanged), DELETE open ok; invalid pizza flavor -> 400 'Sabor inválido'; encomenda empty name 422, blank '   ' 400, negative deposit 422, deposit>total 400; PATCH encomenda bogus status 400, negative deposit 422, valid status persisted. 3 new minor backend gaps found (see minor). minor.issue: A 'cancelada' order can be reopened: PATCH {status:'aberta'} returns 200 (guard only checks 'fechada'). Same for POST /orders/{id}/items (200 on cancelled order) and likely /checkout and DELETE items. Fix: guard with order['status'] not in ORDER_EDITABLE_STATUSES -> 400 in update_order, add_item, remove_item, checkout_order.
deposit not checked against encomenda total (deposit total+1000 -> 200). POST checks this, PATCH does not.
Unknown id returns 200 with null body instead of 404 (DELETE /encomendas/{id} also returns ok for unknown id).

ui_bugs.issue: updStatus() and remove() have no try/catch - backend errors are silent/unhandled; status Select trigger and delete (trash) button lack data-testid
When reopened via 'Opções' to edit, confirm button still says 'Adicionar' (cosmetic; could be 'Salvar')

issues: 'Item adicionado' toast (bottom) overlaps the lower part of the CheckoutDialog (Cancelar button) for a few seconds

action_items: Block edits on cancelled orders: in update_order/add_item/remove_item/checkout_order reject when status in ('fechada','cancelada')
PATCH /encomendas: validate deposit <= encomenda total and return 404 for unknown id
Encomendas: wrap updStatus/remove in try/catch with toast.error; add data-testid to status select and delete button
